title: AliExpress: 20% Cashback on Affiliated Items ($50 Cap Per Order) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: AliExpress: 20% Cashback on Affiliated Items ($50 Cap Per Order) @ TopCashback AU

[Hiphopopotamus] There's a pattern forming. Highest rate for 2 days, smaller rate for another day then back to regular until the next sale.
[Quoc11] my products are now 3% cheaper… so i think it's all priced in.
[Low Punt] Can anyone suggest AM4 and AM5 itx mobos that are not rubbish?
[scud70] I got (from Ali E) and use a Maxsun B650 one but i'm guessing that would be in the rubbish tier in some circles hehe Works with my 7800X3D no issues and has all that i need for my setup. AM4 i'm sure you can get some cheap ones here in Aus but not sure if the prices have gone up due to the rampocalypse… i'd assume there'd be an AM4 version by Maxsun. I will caveat this with if you are not an "enthusiast" and been around this stuff for a long time don't bother with the chinese brand boards as troubleshooting wise you are on your own or at the mercy of forums with next to no useful info.
[dajackal] Fingers crossed my earlier order ships in time so I can use the OzB cashback before this deal ends
[Riqodex] My purchase from yesterday still has not tracked 🫠
[Samson2020] Mine either, I ordered from laptop, didnt track, cancelled re-ordered on mobile still didn't track. think Ali Express tracking is defo broken…
[jjvog1920] Mine also. I got an email from TopCashback to say they'd tracked my click as it was the first time I'd used them but nothing has turned up yet.
[Herring8684] Ali tracking is a coin toss at best, don't rely on it.
[Sblogz] Can anyone suggest a good Skeleton watch

And any general daily dress watch besides the usual culprits - Addiesdive, Steeldive

Do you need one more?
[Aaroninau] Uncapped cashback from Topcashback UK is over?
[hybir] They added new terms to restrict orders to UK destination only, so it's not really worth gambling with.
[chyawala] Will be interesting to see how it plays out with all the tracked orders stuck on pending going well beyond expected time frames. A lot of transactions were made months before the new restrictions. So its up to TCB to fulfill this. I know it's their UK site, but it still forms part of my trust with TCB as a whole. I am waiting for TCB UK to fulfill well overdue payout before using TCB AU again. Looks like this issue will be discussed in the TCB AU threads now that TCB UK posts are no longer able to be posted.
[Aaroninau] I have a few hundred dollars cashback pending in TCB UK too. Will be disappointed if TCB UK dont fulfill it.
[Advantan] Is this deal separate to the 23% cashback?
This 20% cashback T&Cs say "Effective 5PM AEST 07/09/2026" which is last week, so if I've maxed out the $50 cashback from the 23% deal, then do I have another $50 cashback from this 20% deal?
[Hiphopopotamus] Cap is per order, 23% expired.
The $50 cap is new, expect the description to be changed eventually.
[tj warren] Does it track if using the aliexpress app?
